summary.what_it_is: Mister Download Manager is a free, open-source download manager written in Rust for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It supports HTTP, BitTorrent, magnet links, video downloading, and debrid services, and includes browser extensions.
summary.why_trending: It is a new, feature-rich, free alternative to Internet Download Manager with torrent and video downloading support, written in Rust, which has attracted rapid attention.
summary.who_its_for: Users who want a free, cross-platform download manager with torrent and video downloading capabilities.
